description: This file is a C# source file that sets up a minimal web API using ASP.NET Core. It configures services like OpenAPI/Swagger, CORS policies, and defines a health check endpoint.

methods.name: MapGet
methods.description: Defines a GET endpoint at '/' that returns a simple health status message.

methods.name: UseCors
methods.description: Enables the CORS policy named 'AllowAll' for the application.

methods.name: UseSwaggerUi
methods.description: Configures Swagger UI to serve API documentation at '/docs'.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the web application and begins listening for incoming requests.
